name: starter
label: Starter
description: The reference template for the Port60 dialect — the developer docs' worked example and the base to copy when building your own. 1.1.0 adds the layout slot: the template owns the header, navigation and footer chrome.
changelog: Declares image advice: the ideal photo shape for this hero, shown beside the upload in your editor.

hero.note: Landscape around 16:9 fills the hero cleanly; panoramas suit the whole-photo framing.
